meaning:
ἀπο-κυλίω
(see: κυλίω), [in LXX: Gen.29:3, 8 29:10 (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;]
to roll away: Mat.28:2, Mrk.16:3, Luk.24:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.
They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
